evidence.V1: Silhouette is a lumpy flat-topped blob; reads as a bush mostly from colour in the front view, from the top/side it could be a rock or jelly mound.
evidence.V2: Only a few bottom lobes and six berries; the dominant form is a flat light-green plateau with no layered medium puffs.
evidence.V3: Flat cut-off top with a hard ring (three-quarter, puffs close-up) makes it look like a cake rather than a full rounded stylised bush.
evidence.V4: Mostly soft, but a crease ridge where the flat top meets the sides and polygonal lobe outlines; edges are not consistent.
evidence.V5: Visible stray faceting/stepped shading across the lobes and around the top ring (puffs and base close-ups).
evidence.V6: Leaf green in two values plus gold berries; colourways autumn/frost stay disciplined.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, but not the fused smooth puffy shell the nature brief describes; faceted lobes are a minor mismatch.
evidence.V9: Foliage settings: CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery off, Box fidelity, Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Stray faceting on lobe surfaces (puffs and base close-ups)
Hard crease ring between flat top and sides
top_fixes: Replace the flat plateau top with several overlapping rounded puffs of varied size so the top silhouette is bumpy
Raise smoothness on the lobes to remove the stepped faceting
Tuck some berries into the crevices between puffs and vary their size
